Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class ReviewStore

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ReviewStore
public class ReviewStore extends Object
Reviews. Seller ratings are derived from the visible ones at read time. Every review is saved to the reviews table when added, later changes (hidden, seller reply) by save(com.hkust.marketplace.models.Review); load() rebuilds them at startup.

    • newestFirst

      public static Comparator<Review> newestFirst()
      Newest first. Reviews written within the same clock tick share a timestamp, so the later insert (higher R id) breaks the tie; without this, ties kept insertion order and showed the oldest review first.
